title: Property Facet -- properties.yaml
description: SDD-R011 §7. A list of typed, measurable characteristics of the owning Engineering Knowledge Object. As of WORK_PACKAGE_002 (REFERENCE-TASK-000012): `property_id` is a permanent identifier, never the display name; display_name may change freely. REFERENCE-TASK-000011: `unit_ref` must resolve to a Unit EKO's object_id -- `unit_symbol_pending` is the documented, validator-tracked escape hatch for properties whose true unit has no compiled Unit EKO yet (see docs/SCHEMA_MIGRATION.md). REFERENCE-TASK-000014: `constraints` are structured, not free text.

property_id.description: Permanent, stable identifier (REFERENCE-TASK-000012) -- never renamed once published, unlike display_name.

value_type.description: SDD-R001 §9 Value Type / SDD-R011 §7 Primitive Data Type.

unit_ref.description: Object ID of a compiled Unit EKO (SDD-R011 §7: "Units shall reference Unit Engineering Knowledge Objects"). Mutually exclusive with unit_symbol_pending -- exactly one should be set for a numeric property with a unit.

unit_symbol_pending.description: A plain unit symbol (e.g. "Ω") used ONLY when no compiled Unit EKO exists yet for this unit. Tracked by the validator as a documented, temporary exception (REFERENCE-TASK-000011) -- never silently treated as equivalent to a resolved unit_ref.

value.description: The fixed/constant value, when read_only is true (SDD-R011 §7 "Value"). Any JSON scalar.

default_value.description: The suggested starting value for an editable (read_only: false) property (SDD-R011 §7 "Default Value"). Any JSON scalar, or null if this property has no default.

range.description: Simple numeric bounds, kept alongside the richer `constraints` list below for the common min/max case.

constraints.description: REFERENCE-TASK-000014 structured constraints beyond simple range (e.g. cross-property or non-numeric predicates).

visibility.description: SDD-R011 §7 property-level Visibility -- distinct from the object-level `visibility` field WORK_PACKAGE_001 carried under classification, which was dropped (docs/SCHEMA_MIGRATION.md).
